title: Lurchwork
prompt: aphex twin. Energy: half-time, mid. Register focus: melody-led arpeggio over a heavy half-time kit. Palette: OberheimDMX kit + plucked arpeggio. Tempo: 96 BPM. Arc shape: slow-burn build. Mood modifier: brooding, off-kilter, lurching.
description: A brooding half-time beat on a dusty OberheimDMX kit anchors a plucked minor arpeggio that slowly mutates from clean pluck into bit-crushed FM grit. Over a slow-burn build the harmony lurches from C minor into phrygian and back, euclidean hats stagger off the grid, and a delay tail trails every phrase into the dark.
